key_decisions.rationale: Preserves Paul's emphatic denial and divine commissioning.
key_decisions.before: Paul, an apostle—not from human beings or through a human being, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised him from the dead—
key_decisions.after: Paul, an apostle—not from human beings nor through a human being, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Paul, an apostle—not from human beings nor through a human, but through Jesus Christ and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves self-giving, rescue, temporal evil, and divine will.
key_decisions.before: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
key_decisions.after: who gave himself for our sins to rescue us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: who gave himself for our sins to deliver us from the present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves surprise, personal desertion, grace, and interrupted clause.
key_decisions.before: I am amazed that you are turning so quickly from the one who called you by Christ’s grace to a different good news—
key_decisions.after: I am astonished that you are so quickly deserting the one who called you by Christ's grace and turning to a different gospel—
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: I am astonished that you are so quickly turning away from the one who called you in the grace of Christ to a different good news—

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves universal condition and severe curse.
key_decisions.before: But even if we or an angel from heaven should announce to you a good news contrary to what we announced to you, let that one be under a curse.
key_decisions.after: But even if we or an angel from heaven should proclaim to you a gospel contrary to the one we proclaimed to you, let that one be accursed!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But even if we or an angel from heaven should proclaim to you a good news contrary to the one we proclaimed to you, let him be accursed.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps deliberate repetition and received message.
key_decisions.before: As we have said before, I now say again: if anyone announces to you a good news contrary to what you received, let that one be under a curse.
key_decisions.after: As we have said before, so now I say again: if anyone proclaims to you a gospel contrary to what you received, let that one be accursed!
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: As we have said before, so now I say again: if anyone proclaims to you a good news contrary to what you received, let him be accursed.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves rhetorical questions and servant allegiance.
key_decisions.before: Am I now trying to win human approval or God’s? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be Christ’s servant.
key_decisions.after: Am I now seeking human approval, or God's? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still pleasing people, I would not be Christ's servant.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For am I now seeking the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please human beings? If I were still pleasing human beings, I would not be a servant of Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both denials and revelation's possible source/content relation.
key_decisions.before: I did not receive it from a human being, nor was I taught it; I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.after: For I neither received it from a human being nor was I taught it; rather, I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for I did not receive it from a human, nor was I taught it, but I received it through a revelation of Jesus Christ.

key_decisions.rationale: Names Paul's former religious setting and actual violence.
key_decisions.before: You have heard about my former way of life in Judaism: how intensely I persecuted God’s church and tried to destroy it.
key_decisions.after: For you have heard about my former way of life in Judaism: I intensely persecuted God's church and tried to destroy it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For you have heard of my former way of life in Judaism, how I persecuted the church of God beyond measure and tried to destroy it,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps comparison, kinship, and ancestral zeal.
key_decisions.before: I was advancing in Judaism beyond many people my own age among my people, being far more zealous for the traditions of my ancestors.
key_decisions.after: I advanced in Judaism beyond many contemporaries among my people, being far more zealous for my ancestral traditions.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and I advanced in Judaism beyond many of my contemporaries among my people, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my ancestors.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves prophetic calling language and suspended sentence.
key_decisions.before: But when God, who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace, was pleased
key_decisions.after: But when God, who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me through his grace, was pleased
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But when the one who set me apart from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace was pleased

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps inward/through-me ambiguity and mission purpose.

key_decisions.after: to reveal his Son in me so that I might proclaim him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult flesh and blood,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to reveal his Son in me, so that I might proclaim him among the Gentiles, I did not immediately consult with flesh and blood,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps source-form Cephas and exact durations.
key_decisions.before: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Cephas and stayed with him fifteen days.
key_decisions.after: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to get acquainted with Cephas, and I stayed with him fifteen days.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Cephas and remained with him fifteen days;

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the exception and specific relationship.
key_decisions.before: I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
key_decisions.after: I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord's brother.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: but I saw none of the other apostles except James, the brother of the Lord.

key_decisions.after: I was still unknown by sight to the churches of Judea that are in Christ.
